LibTmux.Query.Occurrence

Description

Context-preserving pane appearances for LibTmux.Query.

These tmux 3.3a baseline relationships read detached PaneOccurrence values. Filtering occurrences preserves repeated appearances; use the physical pane source when uniqueness should ignore links.
